messages.content: "請你幫我做幾個計算和搜尋嗎？首先，我想計算一個底為15公尺、高為20公尺的三角形的面積，並且希望結果以平方公尺表示。然後，我有兩組數據，我想要進行統計比較。第一組數據包含12、15、18、20、22和25，第二組數據包含14、16、19、21、23和26。我想進行一個顯著性水平為0.05的t檢驗。之後，我想找到洛杉磯未來14天的搖滾音樂會。最後，我想計算另一個三角形的面積，這次的底為10公尺、高為30公尺，同樣希望結果以平方公尺表示。"

function.name: t_test
function.description: Perform a statistical t-test to check if the means of two independent datasets are statistically different. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

alpha.description: Significance level for the test. Default is 0.05. This is a float type value.

function.name: geometry_area_triangle
function.description: Calculate the area of a triangle. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

base.description: The length of the base of the triangle.

height.description: The height of the triangle from the base.

unit.description: The measurement unit for the area. Defaults to square meters.

function.name: event_finder_find_upcoming
function.description: Find upcoming events of a specific genre in a given location. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: The city and state where the search will take place, e.g. New York, NY.

days_ahead.description: The number of days from now to include in the search.
